1.w: For the music director, a psalm of David, written when Nathan the prophet confronted him after David’s affair with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, because of your loyal love. Because of your great compassion, wipe away my rebellious acts.

2.w: Wash away my wrongdoing. Cleanse me of my sin.

3.w: For I am aware of my rebellious acts; I am forever conscious of my sin.

4.w: Against you—you above all —I have sinned; I have done what is evil in your sight. So you are just when you confront me; you are right when you condemn me.

5.w: Look, I was guilty of sin from birth, a sinner the moment my mother conceived me.

6.w: Look, you desire integrity in the inner man; you want me to possess wisdom.

7.w: Cleanse me with hyssop and I will be pure; wash me and I will be whiter than snow.

8.w: Grant me the ultimate joy of being forgiven. May the bones you crushed rejoice.

9.w: Hide your face from my sins. Wipe away all my guilt.

10.w: Create for me a pure heart, O God. Renew a resolute spirit within me.

11.w: Do not reject me. Do not take your Holy Spirit away from me.

12.w: Let me again experience the joy of your deliverance. Sustain me by giving me the desire to obey.

13.w: Then I will teach rebels your merciful ways, and sinners will turn to you.

14.w: Rescue me from the guilt of murder, O God, the God who delivers me. Then my tongue will shout for joy because of your righteousness.

15.w: O Lord, give me the words. Then my mouth will praise you.

16.w: Certainly you do not want a sacrifice, or else I would offer it; you do not desire a burnt sacrifice.

17.w: The sacrifice God desires is a humble spirit — O God, a humble and repentant heart you will not reject.

18.w: Because you favor Zion, do what is good for her. Fortify the walls of Jerusalem.

19.w: Then you will accept the proper sacrifices, burnt sacrifices and whole offerings; then bulls will be sacrificed on your altar.
